Marigold Mandap Decorators — Wedding Decor & Florals, Jaipur

Marigold Mandap is a Jaipur decor house specializing in traditional floral
mandaps, marigold and rose installations, and classic stage backdrops for
North Indian weddings.

Pricing: an older 2022 brochure lists standard mandap packages at ₹1,80,000.
A 2024 Instagram highlight mentions "packages from ₹2,60,000," and a printed
flyer still circulating quotes ₹1,80,000. There is no single confirmed current
rate, so request a written quote with the current date before booking.

Contact: +91 98291 56473 · hello@marigoldmandap.example
Location: Malviya Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan
Rating: 4.4 / 5 (96 reviews)

Marigold Mandap is a dependable choice for couples wanting a classic, floral-
